script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

JENNY, a single mother in her 30s, is making breakfast for her two children, MARK, 8, and SAMANTHA, 6.

JENNY
(to herself)
Another day, another dollar.

MARK
Mom, can I help?

Jenny smiles and hands him a bowl.

JENNY
Sure, sweetie. Cereal, please.

As Jenny finishes making breakfast, SAMANTHA enters the room, holding a picture she drew.

SAMANTHA
Look, Mom! I drew you and me and Mark.

Jenny looks at the picture, touched.

JENNY
That's beautiful, Samantha. You're very talented.

Suddenly, the doorbell rings. Jenny looks concerned.

JENNY
(to the kids)
Stay here. I'll be right back.

INT. ENTRANCEWAY - CONTINUOUS

Jenny opens the door to find MIKE, an old friend she hasn't seen in years. He looks disheveled and haggard.

MIKE
Jenny! I'm so glad I found you.

JENNY
(surprised)
Mike! What are you doing here?

MIKE
I need your help. I've lost my job and I have nowhere to go. Can I stay with you for a while?

INT. KITCHEN - LATER

Jenny sits at the table with Mark and Samantha, explaining the situation to them.

JENNY
Boys and girls, this is Mike. He's my old friend and he's lost his job and needs a place to stay for a while.

MARK
(excitedly)
Cool! Another boy!

SAMANTHA
Can he play with us?

JENNY
(smiling)
Of course, sweetie. He can play with you when he's not looking for work.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

Mike sits on the couch, looking at his resume. Jenny enters the room.

JENNY
(kindly)
Is there anything I can do to help you find a job, Mike?

MIKE
(sadly)
I appreciate it, Jenny. But I don't want to burden you.

JENNY
(firmly)
You're not a burden, Mike. You're my friend.

INT. PARK - DAY

Mark, Samantha, and Mike are playing catch in the park. Jenny watches from a distance, smiling.

JENNY
(to herself)
This is nice. They're having so much fun.

Suddenly, a group of kids come running towards them, wanting to join in the game.

MARK
Sure! You can play with us!

Jenny looks on, pleased to see her children making new friends.

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

Jenny, Mike, and the kids are sitting around the table, eating dinner.

JENNY
(to Mike)
How's the job search going?

MIKE
(sighs)
It's been slow going. But I'll keep trying.

SAMANTHA
(to Mike)
You're a good athlete. Have you thought about trying out for a sports team?

MIKE
(smiling)
I haven't, but that's a great idea, Samantha.

JENNY
(proudly)
See, boys and girls? That's the power of a good idea.

INT. LIVING ROOM - EVENING

Mike is on the computer, looking for job listings. Jenny sits next to him, offering encouragement.

JENNY
You'll find something soon, Mike. Don't give up.

MIKE
(smiling)
Thanks, Jenny. I won't.

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

Jenny is making breakfast for the family, with Mike sitting at the table.

MIKE
Jenny, I want to thank you for letting me stay with you and the kids. You've given me a place to call home.

JENNY
(smiling)
You're family, Mike.

The doorbell rings, interrupting their conversation. Jenny goes to answer it, but before she can open the door, she hears good news from the other side.

MIKE
(excitedly)
Jenny, it's the job agency. They want to offer me a position!

Jenny opens the door, revealing the smiling face of the job agent.

JOB AGENT
(to Jenny)
Mrs. Thompson, I'm glad we could find a suitable position for Mr. Williams. He'll be starting next week.

Jenny and Mike exchange excited glances.

JENNY
(to Mike)
See? I told you you'd find something soon.

MIKE
(gratefully)
Thank you, Jenny. And thank you for your support.

Jenny smiles, knowing that she's made a difference in her friend's life.

FADE OUT.
